# @miozu/jera

> Zero-dependency, AI-first component library for Svelte 5. Pure modern CSS with Base16 design tokens. 85 components across 7 categories.

## Quick Start

```bash
pnpm add @miozu/jera    # or link:../jera for monorepo
```

```svelte
import { Button, Input, Modal, Tabs } from '@miozu/jera';
import { getTheme } from '@miozu/jera';
import { clickOutside } from '@miozu/jera/actions';
import '@miozu/jera/tokens';
```

Full API reference: [llms-full.txt](./llms-full.txt) | Component manifest: [components.json](./components.json)

## Design Tokens (Base16)

- [Colors](./src/tokens/colors.css): Miozu Base16 palette (base00-base0F)
- [Spacing](./src/tokens/spacing.css): 4px-based spacing scale
- [Typography](./src/tokens/typography.css): Font scales and weights
- [Effects](./src/tokens/effects.css): Shadows, radius, transitions, z-index

| Token | Role | Dark | Light |
|-------|------|------|-------|
| base00 | Background | #0f1419 | #ffffff |
| base01 | Surface | #1a1f26 | #f8f9fa |
| base02 | Border/Selection | #2c3038 | #e9ecef |
| base05 | Text | #e2e8f0 | #212529 |
| base08 | Error/Red | #e06c75 | #dc3545 |
| base0B | Success/Green | #98c379 | #28a745 |
| base0D | Primary/Blue | #61afef | #007bff |

## Active Components

Used in production across dash.selify.ai, admin.selify.ai, and miozu.com.

### Primitives
- [Avatar](./src/components/primitives/Avatar.svelte): User avatar with image, algorithmic Truchet fallback, initials, and status indicator
- [Badge](./src/components/primitives/Badge.svelte): Status tag with semantic color variants, optional indicator dot, and icon support. Bordered tinted style (10% bg, 30% border, 2px radius).
- [Button](./src/components/primitives/Button.svelte): Primary action trigger, polymorphic (a/button)
- [DashCard](./src/components/primitives/DashCard.svelte): Glassmorphism dashboard section card with stagger-fade animation on mount
- [Divider](./src/components/primitives/Divider.svelte): Visual separator with optional label
- [Stat](./src/components/primitives/Stat.svelte): Metric display with optional progress bar
- [ThemeSelect](./src/components/primitives/ThemeSelect.svelte): Three-option theme selector (light/dark/system)
- [ThemeToggle](./src/components/primitives/ThemeToggle.svelte): Animated sun/moon theme switcher

### Forms
- [ButtonInput](./src/components/forms/ButtonInput.svelte): Input with attached button for search, submit, or inline actions
- [Checkbox](./src/components/forms/Checkbox.svelte): Checkbox with label via children snippet
- [Input](./src/components/forms/Input.svelte): Flexible text input with full browser feature control, error states, and aria-invalid accessibility
- [SearchInput](./src/components/forms/SearchInput.svelte): Search field with icon, clear button, loading state
- [Select](./src/components/forms/Select.svelte): Native select element styled with base16 tokens
- [Switch](./src/components/forms/Switch.svelte): Accessible toggle switch for boolean values with smooth CSS transitions
- [Textarea](./src/components/forms/Textarea.svelte): Multiline text input with optional auto-resize

### Feedback
- [Alert](./src/components/feedback/Alert.svelte): Inline alert with icon and actions
- [EmptyState](./src/components/feedback/EmptyState.svelte): Empty data placeholder
- [ProgressBar](./src/components/feedback/ProgressBar.svelte): Determinate/indeterminate progress indicator
- [Skeleton](./src/components/feedback/Skeleton.svelte): Loading placeholder with shimmer animation. Variant mode for primitives, preset mode for layout patterns.
- [Spinner](./src/components/feedback/Spinner.svelte): Loading indicator
- [Toast](./src/components/feedback/Toast.svelte): Enterprise toast system — singleton state, dual progress (ring/bar), pause-on-hover, Svelte transitions, popover top-layer

### Overlays
- [ConfirmDialog](./src/components/overlays/ConfirmDialog.svelte): Pre-built confirmation modal
- [Modal](./src/components/overlays/Modal.svelte): Dialog overlay with variants and fill mode
- [Popover](./src/components/overlays/Popover.svelte): Hover popover with CSS Anchor Positioning

### Navigation
- [Accordion](./src/components/navigation/Accordion.svelte): Collapsible content sections
- [AccordionItem](./src/components/navigation/AccordionItem.svelte): Expandable item with title and custom indicator
- [DropdownContainer](./src/components/navigation/DropdownContainer.svelte): User account menu with theme toggle and sign out
- [LeftBar](./src/components/navigation/LeftBar.svelte): Collapsible sidebar with context and persistence
- [LeftBarGroup](./src/components/navigation/LeftBarGroup.svelte): Dynamic item group with search and avatar support
- [LeftBarItem](./src/components/navigation/LeftBarItem.svelte): Nav item with icon, badge, expandable subroutes
- [LeftBarSection](./src/components/navigation/LeftBarSection.svelte): Grouped navigation section with title
- [LeftBarToggle](./src/components/navigation/LeftBarToggle.svelte): Sidebar collapse toggle, reads LeftBar context
- [NavBar](./src/components/navigation/NavBar.svelte): Horizontal mega-menu navigation bar
- [Tabs](./src/components/navigation/Tabs.svelte): Tab navigation with animated sliding indicator and configurable accent color

### Layout
- [BottomPanel](./src/components/layout/BottomPanel.svelte): Slide-up panel with drag-to-resize
- [PageHeader](./src/components/layout/PageHeader.svelte): Flexible page header with stats and action slots
- [SettingCard](./src/components/layout/SettingCard.svelte): Settings group card
- [SettingItem](./src/components/layout/SettingItem.svelte): Individual setting row

### Docs
- [CodeBlock](./src/components/docs/CodeBlock.svelte): Syntax-highlighted code with Shiki and copy button

## Ready Components

Built and tested but not yet used in production. Available for immediate adoption.

### Primitives (Ready)
- [Card](./src/components/primitives/Card.svelte): Bordered container with optional title and semantic color variants
- [ChecklistCard](./src/components/primitives/ChecklistCard.svelte): Sequential onboarding checklist. Shows steps with done/current/future states. Auto-hides when all steps complete.
- [DistributionBar](./src/components/primitives/DistributionBar.svelte): Horizontal segmented bar with auto-calculated percentages and optional legend
- [FilterChip](./src/components/primitives/FilterChip.svelte): Toggleable filter chip with active state indicator
- [LazyImage](./src/components/primitives/LazyImage.svelte): Image with IntersectionObserver lazy loading and fade-in animation
- [Link](./src/components/primitives/Link.svelte): Polymorphic link/button with arrow icon that shifts on hover
- [LinkCard](./src/components/primitives/LinkCard.svelte): Full-width clickable card rendered as anchor with label and trailing slot
- [MemberCard](./src/components/primitives/MemberCard.svelte): Team member row with avatar, status dot, role, timestamp, and hover actions
- [MetricCard](./src/components/primitives/MetricCard.svelte): Dashboard KPI card with icon, value, unit, progress bar, and auto-colored thresholds
- [StatusLine](./src/components/primitives/StatusLine.svelte): Horizontal row of items separated by configurable delimiter
- [Tooltip](./src/components/primitives/Tooltip.svelte): Hover/focus tooltip with arrow pointer, delay, and optional rich content snippet

### Forms (Ready)
- [CardRadioGroup](./src/components/forms/CardRadioGroup.svelte): Single-choice radio group rendered as stacked cards with title + description. Clearer than native Select for 2-6 high-stakes options (roles, plans, modes).
- [Dropzone](./src/components/forms/Dropzone.svelte): Single-file drag-and-drop zone with file preview and type validation
- [FileUpload](./src/components/forms/FileUpload.svelte): Drag-and-drop upload zone with file list, size validation, and multi-file support
- [IconInput](./src/components/forms/IconInput.svelte): Input with leading/trailing icon slots, loading spinner, and clear button
- [ImageDropzone](./src/components/forms/ImageDropzone.svelte): Drag-and-drop image upload with preview grid and file validation
- [NumberInput](./src/components/forms/NumberInput.svelte): Stepper input with decrement/increment buttons and min/max enforcement
- [OptionCard](./src/components/forms/OptionCard.svelte): Selectable option card for multi-choice layouts
- [PinInput](./src/components/forms/PinInput.svelte): OTP/PIN code entry with per-digit inputs, auto-advance, and paste support
- [Radio](./src/components/forms/Radio.svelte): Single radio button with animated dot indicator (use inside RadioGroup)
- [RadioGroup](./src/components/forms/RadioGroup.svelte): Radio group container with context for child Radio components
- [RangeSlider](./src/components/forms/RangeSlider.svelte): Styled range input with fill bar, labels, and custom value formatting

### Overlays (Ready)
- [Dropdown](./src/components/overlays/Dropdown.svelte): Portaled action menu with viewport-aware positioning, keyboard navigation, and ARIA
- [DropdownDivider](./src/components/overlays/DropdownDivider.svelte): Horizontal separator line for dropdown menu groups
- [DropdownItem](./src/components/overlays/DropdownItem.svelte): Menu item with role=menuitem, keyboard support, icon and danger variant
- [Sheet](./src/components/overlays/Sheet.svelte): Bottom-sheet overlay (native dialog top-layer, drag-to-dismiss)

### Docs (Ready)
- [DocSection](./src/components/docs/DocSection.svelte): Documentation section with heading, anchor link, and configurable heading level
- [PropsTable](./src/components/docs/PropsTable.svelte): Styled API documentation table with type chips and default value highlights
- [SplitPane](./src/components/docs/SplitPane.svelte): Two-column layout with configurable ratio, responsive stacking, and optional sticky right pane

## Legacy Components

Previous implementations replaced by newer versions. Kept for backward compatibility.

### Navigation (Legacy -- replaced by LeftBar)
- Sidebar, TabNav, SidebarSection, SidebarItem, SidebarGroup, SidebarPopover, SidebarToggle

### Navigation (Legacy)
- NavigationContainer, ScrollNav, WorkspaceMenu, SidebarSearch, SidebarGroupSwitcher, SidebarAccountGroup, SidebarAccountItem, SidebarNavigationItem, LeftBarPopover, ChipNav, NavigationSearch, NavigationSection, NavigationAccountGroup, NavigationGroupSwitcher, NavigationCustomBlock

## Utilities
- [cn()](./src/utils/cn.svelte.js): Class name concatenation with falsy filtering
- [cv()](./src/utils/cn.svelte.js): Class variants for type-safe variant composition
- [getTheme()](./src/utils/reactive.svelte.js): SSR-safe theme singleton — `getTheme().init()`, `.toggle()`, `.isDark`
- [createActiveChecker()](./src/utils/navigation.svelte.js): Route matching utility for nav items

## Actions
- [clickOutside](./src/actions/index.js): Detect clicks outside element
- [focusTrap](./src/actions/index.js): Trap focus within element
- [escapeKey](./src/actions/index.js): Handle escape key press
- [portal](./src/actions/index.js): Render in different DOM location

## Rules for AI

1. Svelte 5 runes only ($state, $derived, $props) — no legacy stores
2. Single $props() call per component
3. Use Base16 tokens (var(--color-baseXX)) — no hardcoded hex
4. Zero external dependencies — only Svelte as devDep
5. All styles are scoped pure CSS — no Tailwind, no CSS frameworks
6. Components must work in any pure CSS environment
7. Forward rest props via {...rest} on the root element
8. Use $bindable() for two-way binding props (value, checked, open, collapsed)
